level_reasons: Break My Fix finding 1: an input that breaks clldutils.badge.badge

issue.title: The `badge` function should be more flexible

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the original issue, confirmed the fix guards it with no regressions found and full fix-line coverage, but Break My Fix found an input that breaks clldutils.badge.badge: badge(subject='a b', status='c', color='blue', markdown=False) returns 'https://img.shields.io/badge/a%20b-c-blue.svg'. Check how the fixed code escapes spaces and other special characters in subject/status…

survivors.original: quote(subject), quote(status), color, fmt, '?' + urlencode(kw) if kw else '')
survivors.replacement: subject, quote(status), color, fmt, '?' + urlencode(kw) if kw else '')
survivors.diff:
--- a/clldutils/badge.py
+++ b/clldutils/badge.py
@@ -24,3 +24,3 @@
     url = 'https://img.shields.io/badge/{0}-{1}-{2}.{3}{4}'.format(
-        quote(subject), quote(status), color, fmt, '?' + urlencode(kw) if kw else '')
+        subject, quote(status), color, fmt, '?' + urlencode(kw) if kw else '')
     return '![{0}]({1} "{0}")'.format(label, url) if markdown else url
survivors.words: clldutils/badge.py:25: changing `quote(subject), quote(status), color, fmt, '?' + urlencode(k...` to `subject, quote(status), color, fmt, '?' + urlencode(kw) if k...` made no test fail; no input tried behaved differently from the fix (it may be equivalent)
